items.item_text: A current, California Certified Phlebotomy Technician certification.
Minimum of 2 years of recent experience performing phlebotomy in a high-volume testing laboratory (post receiving CPT certificate).
High school diploma or equivalent (e.g. GED or HiSET).

As a Laboratory Technician 2 at the BURL Outreach Clinical Laboratory in Torrance, you will play a vital role in supporting laboratory operations and providing high-quality phlebotomy services. Your duties will include:
Perform phlebotomy on patients of all ages.
Assist in coordination of couriers and routes, including follow-ups on service delays.
Triage all lab samples and requests after verification of appropriate information.
Enter and verify patient and test info into computer.
Generate computer labels for specimens and deliver to appropriate areas.
Prepare samples for transport to referral labs or storage.
Document draws, added tests, and cancelled/rejected specimens.

May be required to provide coverage as needed at all BURL locations including Westlake Village, Thousand Oaks, Woodland Hills, Santa Clarita, Porter Ranch, Calabasas, Burbank, Century City, Encino, Panorama City, and Torrance.
Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability to work at other draw stations as needed (e.g. Panorama City, Torrance, Burbank, Encino, Calabasas, Westlake Village, Woodland Hills, Porter Ranch, Thousand Oaks, and Century City).
Knowledgeable in quality assurance practices, preferred.
Availability to work weekends, holidays and other shifts as needed.
Skill in performing related computer procedures (LIS, HIS).
